query:
SELECT 
  cpr.id, 
  cpr.segment, 
  cpr.city, 
  cpr.status, 
  cpr.tenantId,
  u.name as userName,
  u.email as userEmail
FROM commercialPointRequests cpr
LEFT JOIN users u ON cpr.userId = u.id;
